entries.what: Indigenous Peoples' Day, no classes at Tamsen Valley. Rafael sleeps in, then services the stand's 3500W generator in the driveway off Pell Road.
entries.outcome: Generator runs clean and is ready for the new lot.

entries.what: Afternoon at Delgado Park for pickup soccer with friends, then a ride home in the Taco with horchata.
entries.outcome: Tired legs, good mood.

entries.what: Late evening he watches engine teardown videos in bed and studies his voice-memo flashcards for the G1.
entries.outcome: Listens through the whole flashcard set once.

entries.what: Tuesday engine performance with Salas from 1 to 4 at Tamsen Valley, diagnosing a misfire on a lab Civic.
entries.outcome: Finds the bad coil by ear and keeps his bay clean.

entries.what: After class he browses used scan tools at length, comparing listings and setting a firm $700 cap before he will buy anything. He has been researching for weeks.
entries.outcome: Shortlists three tools and buys nothing yet.

entries.what: Evening fills up the Taco at the Ruel Road station, then eats dinner with his parents.
entries.outcome: Gas stays at about $50 for the week.

entries.what: Wednesday brakes lab from 8 to 11 at Tamsen Valley. Midterm week means a busy campus and a packed Lot C.
entries.outcome: Finishes the brake job before the bell.

entries.what: Midday he studies G1 flashcards in the library with earbuds in, among midterm crammers.
entries.outcome: Gets through two chapters of cards.

entries.what: Evening he drives Ximena's Corolla around the block to check it, then calls it a night.
entries.outcome: Corolla is fine, no work needed.

entries.what: Thursday engine performance with Salas. After the lab, Salas offers to recommend him to Ortega Auto & Tire if he passes the G1 practice.
entries.outcome: Recommendation is conditional on the G1 practice result.

entries.what: Evening at the Ruel Road lot working the stand 5 to 10, running the griddle while listening to flashcard memos.
entries.outcome: Busy night and a good crowd.

entries.what: After teardown he tells Gladys about Salas's offer on the drive home.
entries.outcome: Gladys is proud and tells him to study.

entries.what: Friday morning he skips class prep and reviews G1 cards over breakfast at home.
entries.outcome: Knows the refrigerant section cold.

entries.what: Works the stand in the evening at the new lot, then leaves at 8:50 to pick up Dulce at Taquería Colima.
entries.outcome: Dulce home by 9:20 and he is back at the stand.

entries.what: Closes the stand and loads the generator and canopy into the truck.
entries.outcome: Home near 11 p.m.

entries.what: Saturday he helps Gladys prep masa and supplies for the evening stand.
entries.outcome: Prep done by noon.

entries.what: Works the stand 5 to 10 at Ruel Road, with Ximena helping that evening as she does Saturdays.
entries.outcome: Good sales, Ximena stays through close.

entries.what: Late he walks Ximena to her Corolla and they talk about his shop dream.
entries.outcome: She nudges him to dream bigger.

entries.what: Sunday late morning he sleeps in, then eats a revuelta pupusa with extra curtido.
entries.outcome: Slow start to the day.

entries.what: Afternoon he reviews G1 flashcards and lines up the week's plan before the stand.
entries.outcome: Plans study time around Tuesday and Thursday classes.

entries.what: Works the stand 5 to 10 at the Ruel Road lot and closes up with his dad.
entries.outcome: Steady night, home by 11.
